# ELITZE · Agentic Security

ELITZE · Agentic Security is a security control plane for systems that use AI agents.

## Canonical sources
- https://elitze-agentic-security.vercel.app/
- https://elitze-agentic-security.vercel.app/platform
- https://elitze-agentic-security.vercel.app/security
- https://elitze-agentic-security.vercel.app/use-cases

## Product scope
- Security Graph
- Security Intelligence
- Policy Engine
- Guardrails
- Sandbox
- Kill Switch / containment
- Non-human identity
- Tool and protocol governance
- CI/CD security gates
- Evidence and audit persistence

## Security model
The security boundary is external to the agent. Identity, authorization, policy, credentials, data access, network controls, sandboxing and containment remain independently enforceable.

## Integrity
ELITZE does not treat unverified telemetry as live production data. Operational values must come from configured services and persistence. Unimplemented controls must not be represented as active protection.
